object.name: evi.lores~
object.description: This filter roughly matches the shape and behaviour of MSP <o>lores~</o> but is implemented as a TPT filter. <o>lores~</o> is basically like the lowpass output of <o>svf~</o> but with a unique mapping and coupling of cutoff and resonance: frequency affects strength of resonance and resonance affects slope of filter. The mapping of <o>lores~</o> has a lower resonance in the low frequency range. This is actually a traditional analog SVF type of mapping. <o>evi.lores~</o> matches all these features but does not quite manage to match the high frequency response. This is a trade off for having a filter with better modulation properties and which does not digitally distort. The abstraction includes code which can be extracted for parameter rate control of the coefficients calculation if required.
object.discussion: For more information about other reimplementations of MSP filters in evieve, see the 'evieve: msp' tab of the helpfile.

attributes.name: oversample
attributes.description: The 2x oversampling improves the high frequency response, more closely matching the MSP original. Also useful if audio rate modulating the filter.
